hypothesis: Reject mean-reversion entries against strong confirmed H1 trends and in very low/high M5 volatility regimes; compare separately and jointly on currentBB and body-engulf entries.
higher_timeframe_rules: Only complete aligned H1 groups containing exactly12 consecutive M5 opens from hh:00 through hh:55. H1 end <= M5 decision close time and age strictly<3600seconds for trend-filter eligibility. Missing/incomplete hours omitted, never fabricated. Latest complete H1 retained for indicator calculation over gaps; rolling indicators count complete observed hours without resetting, but stale H1 rejects until fresh complete hour. SMA20 slope normalized by H1 Wilder ATR14: (SMA20[k]-SMA20[k-3])/ATR14[k]. Block BUY if slope<=-0.25 and SELL if slope>=0.25. Warmup/nonpositive ATR rejects trend candidates. Volatility-only does not require H1 readiness. Underlying M1 completeness is not established by cached M5 alignment.
volatility_rules: M5 Wilder ATR14 current divided by mean of previous100 ATR14 observations, excluding current, must lie inclusively[0.5,2.0]. Current TR/priorATR14<=2.5 inclusive. Gaps included in TR, no fabricated bars. Missing warmup or nonpositive denominators reject.
entry_rules: At first otherwise eligible existing center3 BB signal, apply existing shape0 or shape3 and selected regime filters. Any failure cancels setup/no same-bar rearm/no waiting. Confirmed signal then next available open, BUY and SELL symmetric. Existing context/wick exclusions preserved.

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: existing user moving-center rule retained, not fixed RR
exit_rules.target: previous confirmed M5 SMA20; gap fill at open then intrabar target, advance target after fill check

annual_grouping: Continuous positions across years. Closed trades grouped by exit bar year; no annual position resets. Annual figures exclude open position MTM.
final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously viewed in BB/GMO reports. Entire experiment is descriptive; no untouched validation or holdout claimed.

cost_and_fill_model.scope: Current quoted normal-session spread assumptions applied all hours, not historical actual spreads; source timezone unknown

position_sizing_and_currency: Equal-pip totals, not account-currency returns; one virtual position per symbol
cross_symbol_rule: Same candidate shared all7; at least4 pairs closed net positive at both costs
selection: Evaluate all8 fixed variants once. Report all6 filters against matching baseline. If none eligible reject and keep Pine unchanged; no tuning/fallback. Passing descriptive gates still requires independent review, not live authorization.
